name: Ukor
summary: Ukor is an orc peon resting near the eastern path outside the Valley of Trials in Durotar. Eager to help his people, he carried supplies all the way from Razor Hill, only to find the training grounds already had plenty of provisions.

sections.title: A Peon's Errand
sections.body: While many orc peons spend their lives under the watchful eye of harsh taskmasters cutting lumber or hauling rocks, Ukor attempted to perform a service of his own initiative. Tasked or inspired to bring food from Razor Hill to the recruits training in the Valley of Trials, he made the dangerous trek across Durotar's red plains past prowling scorpid and boars. Upon arrival, he discovered the Valley was already well-stocked and had no need for his bundle. Exhausted and somewhat disheartened by the roadside, he relies on passing young adventurers to return the unused provisions back north to Innkeeper Grosk.

faq.answer: Ukor is an earnest orc peon stationed along the road leading east out of the Valley of Trials in southern Durotar.

faq.q: Why is Ukor standing by the road with a sack of food?
faq.answer: Ukor carried a heavy bundle of rations down from Razor Hill to feed the young warriors training in the Valley of Trials. When he arrived, he found they had no shortage of provisions, leaving him stranded with unneeded food.

faq.q: What does Ukor ask passing travelers to do?
faq.answer: Too afraid of the beasts along the road to carry the sack back himself, Ukor asks fledgling adventurers heading north toward Razor Hill to return the bundle to Innkeeper Grosk.

angles.text: Orc peons bear the hard physical labor that builds the new Horde, and Ukor shows that even humble laborers possess a strong desire to support the warriors of Durotar.
For new recruits emerging from their trials, aiding Ukor marks one of the first opportunities to support everyday Horde logistics between settlements.
